name: lumartinez-apps
description: Lumartinez App is a monorepo dedicated to handle common libraries to be used in several projects, making easy to re-use components or libraries without hosting it in npm or articaftory
author: Luis Martínez

scripts.clear: pnpm -r exec rimraf node_modules dist .next .turbo && pnpm exec rimraf node_modules .turbo
scripts.pkg:fix: syncpack fix --config syncpack.config.js && syncpack format --config syncpack.config.js
